problem: Suppose $|\,a\,|=14$ and the angle between vectors $a$ and $b$ is $\theta =\frac{2\pi }{3}.$ Find the scalar projection of $a$ onto $b.$

feedback.problem: Suppose $|\,p\,|=10\sqrt{2}$ and the angle between vectors $p$ and $q$ is $\theta ={45}^{∘}.$ Find the scalar projection of $p$ onto $q.$
feedback.worked_solution:
Using the formula for the scalar projection, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{comp}}_{q}\,p & =|\,p\,|\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta  \\  & =10\sqrt{2}\operatorname{cos}⁡({45}^{∘}) \\  & =10\sqrt{2}\cdot \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} \\  & =10.\end{aligned}
$$
